title: 100 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training Course in Uluwatu Bali
metaTitle: 100 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training in Uluwatu Bali
metaDescription: Experience deep Yin Yoga with our 100 hr TTC in Uluwatu, Bali. Yoga Alliance certified, serene beachfront classes, meditation, anatomy & soulful healing
summary: Learn the basics of Yin Yoga philosophy, anatomy, and teaching methods in easy-to-follow classes.
intro: Uluwatu in Bali is the perfect spot for our 100 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training. This shorter course is ideal for beginners or busy folks who want to learn Yin Yoga’s gentle, restorative style. Practice long, relaxing poses that target your joints, ligaments, and deep tissues to ease stress, improve flexibility, and recharge your energy.

In Uluwatu’s serene setting, you’ll discover how to use props like pillows and blankets to make poses comfy and safe. Learn the basics of Yin Yoga philosophy, anatomy, and teaching methods in easy-to-follow classes. By the end, you’ll earn a certificate and the confidence to lead soothing Yin sessions for yourself or others.
Perfect for those craving a mindful escape, this training blends learning with time to relax and enjoy Bali’s beauty.

curriculum.title: Intermediate – Yang Asanas
items: Virabhadrasana I, II, III, IV (Warrior Series)
Ardha Matsyendrasana (Half Lord of the Fishes Pose)

curriculum.title: Yin Asanas / Yin Yoga Alignment & Adjustment
Philosophy
items: What Is Yin? Meaning, Essence & Goal
Patanjali Yoga Sutras Through a Yin Lens
Overview of the Four Chapters (Pāda) – Yin Perspective
Eight Limbs of Yoga – Yin Interpretation
Understanding the Four Paths of Yoga (Integrated & Yin Perspective)

curriculum.title: Pranayama
items: Yin Postures for Pranayama Practice (Comfort, support & stillness emphasized)
Jal Neti (Yogic Nasal Cleansing) – Yin Approach
Sutra Neti (Yogic Nasal Cleansing) – Yin-Informed Approach

curriculum.title: Meditation
items: Emotional & Mental Landscape in Yin Meditation

dining.text: Every meal is freshly prepared using wholesome plant-based ingredients with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and mindfulness. Our sattvic cuisine supports your yoga practice by nourishing the body, calming the mind, and promoting inner balance throughout your training.
mealTimes: Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one day before the course begins. Your check-in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check-out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.

policies.title: Important Points
items: We cover only the course syllabus that is specifically mentioned on the course page.

policies.title: Booking
items: Advance booking fee: In order to book the course, you are required to deposit the booking fee. We accept the booking fee via Razorpay | Western Union | bank transfer or TransferWise. An official booking confirmation letter will be sent to you shortly after successful advance deposit; the balance of the course fees can be paid on arrival at school either by credit card, debit card or cash.
